description: Schedule 13D/13G filings by holders of 5%+ of a class of registered equity, from January 2024 (none earlier). One row per reporting person per filing; joint filings share accession_number. is_activist true: 13D, intent to influence control; false: 13G, passive. An exit amendment (below 5%) has shares_owned 0 and percent_of_class 0: an exit, not missing data. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_activist_stakes

include_filing_narrative.description: Default false; true adds the 13D narrative, Items 2, 3, 4 (purpose) and 6 (long).

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date; with a numeric sort_by, refused (INVALID_QUERY).

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date; with a numeric sort_by, refused.

name: get_activist_stakes
